content: Yuusufa markiskiɗ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe
Wa ɓa ƴut ŋ ñakta, Yuusufa nakka ƴaara adgohee kahan ce ne : « Tumɗa ƴaaɓii pesoha ini saakuuciŋ ɓa min ɓay, yaa nu nga ɗah, fu ɓekiɗ ɗe haalsiŋ ɗe ŋ saakndiŋ ɗe.
Te fu nam ɓekndoh kaasiŋ ngo haalsi ŋ ɗooƴ saakndiŋ ƴaari uup ƴin nga ɓa. » Ƴaara tummba ina Yuusufa nak ɗe.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, ƴaaɓa woyuusa ne ɓa miniɗ coot ; ɓa siffa mbaam caŋ ɓa, ɓa cooteeɗa.
Ɓa pulla kur ka waaye bala ɓa usan ɗah, Yuusufa woosa ƴaara ne : « Daba ƴaaɓa, fu meekis ɓa ne : Wa ye tah ɓa tumɗuusa baahiɗ po ƴut, ɓa wirndohhaa baahaaɗi ?
Kaasi ɓa rok weɗ mi na anohe te weɗ mi na name markiskoh ; ini ɓa tum sepƴiɗ. »
Ƴaara dabba ɓa, a woosa ɓa ineem.
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne : « Kilifaani, fu na yambe ɓoo ye an ? Ɓoo tumanɗi muk in mand ɗaa.
Fu hot nga, wa ɓoo puloh Kanaan, ɓoo haytoh haytoh haalsi ɓoo raakee ŋ saakuuciŋ ɓoo. Mbaa ɓoo min na rokoh urus wala haalis ŋ kahan kilifaaniŋ ɗa ?
Ɓo' nu fu hot na kaaseem ɗah, a apsaat ; te ɓoo ɓi tas, ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɗa, kilifaani. »
A woosa ɓa ne : « Ee, ŋ teyɗukiɗ ini ɗu woo, waaye a ƴaari rok dong, a yi ŋ amban ñaam, ɓi tas hool nga. »
Ɓa arra ruhsiɗ saakuucaŋ ɓa, yaa nu nga ɗa rangissa waŋ ɗe.
Ƴaara markeeɗa, a cambohha waŋ yakkaŋ ɓa po waŋ ƴaara uup ƴin. Kaasa hotohuusa ŋ saakndaŋ Benyaamin.
Jaarra jaar, keeñ ciŋ ɓa reehha, tahha po ɓa faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɓa. Ƴutta ɓa degissa saakuuca ŋ mbaam caŋ ɓa, ɓa dokkissa ɗiska na Yuusufa.
Wa Yudaa na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ree kahan Yuusufa, ɓa raak ɗe ris nga, ɓa raɗukka ŋ kehƴi, ŋ fikiice.
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne : « Ɗu haɓiɗ ye wii ? Hanaa, ɗu inahɗi ne ɓo' findiiso na mine min markis ? »
Yudaa woosa ɗe ne : « Ɓoo raakɗi woyaah, kilifaani, ɓoo minɗi taasuk po ɓoo hool ŋ inii, laam a Kooh wiñ ɓoo. Ɓoo na hee hey ambsukohe jen ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɗa, ɓoo na ƴaari hotu na kaasi. »
A woosa ɓa ne : « Muk, ŋ supkiɗ tum ineem, a ƴaari hotu na kaasi dong a yi nikan ñaamiŋ ngo ; ɓi tas haad ŋ baabiŋ ɓa moɗoɗ. »
Yudaa kiimɗiɗ Benyaamin
Weɗi Yudaa reɓoh nga ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne : « Kilifaani ɗaas so, on ndo ŋ woo na ɗa, te kanaa so ayruk, laam fu na Firawnaani, e ɗu hend.
Wa ɓoo koc hay ndii, kilifaani, fu meekseen ɓoo ne : Ndah baabiŋ ɓoo ris pes ? Ndah ɓoo raakiɗ taambɗoh wiiriis ?

Ɓoo loffa ɗa ne, kilifaani, baabiŋ ɓoo yaa nga, a yaɓko'iɗ lool te ɓoo raakiɗ taambɗoh ƴin, yi fu inah ne, a raak ɗe ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ɗe. Yakak njaanjeem kaaniɗ, a yi dong a tasiɗ ŋ kuɓuuci a raak na yaayiŋ ɓa, a keeñkohiɗ ɗe lool.
Fu woosa ɓoo ne, ɓoo ɓayɗaat ɗa njaanjeem, fu hotoot ɗe.
Ɓoo woosa ɗa ne, kilifaani : Kuɓkeem minɗi saɓsukoh na baab ɓa. A saɓsukoh na ɗe ɗah, baab ɓa hey kaane.
Fu woosa ɓoo ne kilifaani, feeh taambɗoh ɓoo yeem hayɗi ɗah, fu waaɗisɗi hot ɓoo ŋ fikiifu.
Ɓoo kaɗta ŋ baabiŋ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa, ɓoo woosa ɗe ini fu woo.
Wa a woyis ɓoo ne, ɓoo hayaat ɓa romɗise pesoha,
ɓoo woosa ɗe ne, ɓoo minɗi kaɗ te ɓoo hunɗi na taambɗoh ɓoo, mbaa kilifaanaŋ kur ka teyɗukanɗi ɓoo.
Baabiŋ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa, loffa ɓoo ne : “ Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ raak kuɓu kanak dong na yaay ɓa,
yinoori sooƴiɗ, ŋ amb ne, a sifiñsohuuɗ, ŋ hotisɗi ɗe.
Ɗu waaɗis ɓay yi tas ɗah, ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ngo wii, in rahas ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey haade Jaanim na aay-keeñ saguuɗu. ”
Ɗiski wa nik ndii kilifaani, ŋ haad ŋ baab ɓoo, te ɓoo hunɗi na njaanji a na iikohe ɗah,
a hey kaane ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ɗe, te e ɓoo ɓekan ɗe aay-keeñi ɓayan ɗe Jaanim.
Ɓaatta nga, mi, ŋ haf fo, ñam woyee ɗe ne, a ñam deguka, ne ŋ wikɗi ɗe njaanji ɗah, ahhaaneem taambɗaat to ŋ kipes kiŋ ngo jen.
Mbaa, mi yii kiim ɗa, kilifaani, ne ŋ tas ndii, ŋ nik ñaamiŋ ɗa, te fu faɗ njaanji, a hun na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe a haad.
Ŋ minɗi dokuk muk ŋ baab ɓoo, te ŋ hunɗi na ɗe. Ŋ minɗi maasoh muk naamooni baab na hee kooɗohe ŋ ineem. »
